helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_tenant_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT tenant_id FROM public.users WHERE id = auth.uid();
$function$
helpers.name: get_my_tenant_id

helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.users AS u JOIN public.tenants AS t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
    WHERE u.id = auth.uid() AND u.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active' AND u.role = 'admin'
  );
$function$
helpers.name: is_admin

helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_hq_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$

$function$
helpers.name: is_hq_admin

helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_hq_super_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.users AS u JOIN public.tenants AS t ON t.id = u.tenant_id
    WHERE u.id = auth.uid() AND u.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active'
      AND u.role = 'admin' AND t.product_key = 'bella_hq'
  );
$function$

views.definition:
WITH RECURSIVE current_context AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(auth.uid(), NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_user_id'::text, true), ''::text)::uuid) AS user_id,
            COALESCE(get_auth_tenant_id(), NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id'::text, true), ''::text)::uuid) AS tenant_id
        ), direct_access AS (
         SELECT pd.user_id,
            rel.tenant_id,
            rel.to_id AS org_unit_id,
            rel.to_id AS root_org_unit_id,
            rel.id AS relationship_id,
            rel.rel_type AS access_source
           FROM current_context ctx
             JOIN people_directory pd ON pd.user_id = ctx.user_id AND pd.tenant_id = ctx.tenant_id AND pd.is_active = true
             JOIN org_relationships rel ON rel.tenant_id = pd.tenant_id AND rel.from_id = pd.id AND rel.from_type = 'person'::text AND rel.to_type = 'unit'::text AND (rel.rel_type = ANY (ARRAY['belongs_to'::text, 'manages'::text, 'participates_in'::text])) AND (rel.since IS NULL OR rel.since <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (rel.until IS NULL OR rel.until >= CURRENT_DATE)
             JOIN org_units ou ON ou.id = rel.to_id AND ou.tenant_id = rel.tenant_id AND ou.is_active = true
        ), expanded_access AS (
         SELECT direct_access.user_id,
            direct_access.tenant_id,
            direct_access.org_unit_id,
            direct_access.root_org_unit_id,
            direct_access.relationship_id,
            direct_access.access_source
           FROM direct_access
        UNION
         SELECT ea.user_id,
            child.tenant_id,
            child.id AS org_unit_id,
            ea.root_org_unit_id,
            ea.relationship_id,
            ea.access_source
           FROM expanded_access ea
             JOIN org_units child ON child.parent_id = ea.org_unit_id AND child.tenant_id = ea.tenant_id AND child.is_active = true
        ), admin_access AS (
         SELECT u.id AS user_id,
            ou.tenant_id,
            ou.id AS org_unit_id,
            ou.id AS root_org_unit_id,
            NULL::uuid AS relationship_id,
            'tenant_admin'::text AS access_source
           FROM current_context ctx
             JOIN users u ON u.id = ctx.user_id AND u.tenant_id = ctx.tenant_id AND (lower(u.role) = ANY (ARRAY['admin'::text, 'super_admin'::text]))
             JOIN org_units ou ON ou.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND ou.is_active = true
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT expanded_access.user_id,
    expanded_access.tenant_id,
    expanded_access.org_unit_id,
    expanded_access.root_org_unit_id,
    expanded_access.relationship_id,
    expanded_access.access_source
   FROM expanded_access
UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT admin_access.user_id,
    admin_access.tenant_id,
    admin_access.org_unit_id,
    admin_access.root_org_unit_id,
    admin_access.relationship_id,
    admin_access.access_source
   FROM admin_access;
